scenario: A test fails only on webkit with a pointer-interception error, passes on every other browser
input: tests/ui/products/products-positive-paths.spec.ts's TC-06 failed in the latest CI run. The error is: "TimeoutError: locator.click: Target closed / element intercepts pointer events" on the webkit project only. It passed on chromium, firefox, mobile-chrome, and mobile-safari in the same run. What do you do, and what's your diagnosis?
rubric: Says it needs to look at the actual trace/video/error-context for the webkit run before concluding anything, rather than diagnosing from the description alone
Classifies this as a likely third-party overlay (e.g. an ad iframe) issue given the single-browser, pointer-interception symptom, per the CLAUDE.md classification table
Explicitly rules out "just flaky, add a retry" or raising the timeout as acceptable fixes
If proposing a fix, says it belongs at the network/fixture layer (framework-fixtures.ts), not per-test
Does not propose test.fixme() without first naming a specific defect it would be parked against
